scope: First broad synthetic qualification of v0.7 question/PF routing and selected semantic boundaries. Not a benchmark, generalisation proof, real-data approval, pilot approval, production approval or Phase-F approval.

challenge_semantics.ZS-KI-B-SEM-V07-Q-CHALLENGE-DOC-SYN-001: Document existence/date must not be routed to the object-only question 2.1 merely by thematic association.
challenge_semantics.ZS-KI-B-SEM-V07-Q-CHALLENGE-UNSUPPORTED-: An explicitly unsupported conclusion must not be routed to 7.1 merely because its subject is use/nutzung.
challenge_semantics.ZS-KI-B-SEM-V07-Q-CHALLENGE-TIME-SYN-001: Two clearly dated progressive states must not become a conflict candidate solely because the values differ; 4.5 is forbidden and expected_conflict_candidate=false must be enforced by the future evaluator.
challenge_semantics.ZS-KI-B-SEM-V07-Q-CHALLENGE-POSSIBLE-DAT: A possible date without commitment must preserve modality and must not be treated as a confirmed approval; 3.2 is forbidden.

gold_interpretation.expected_assignments: Required assignments: every listed assignment must be present for PASS.
gold_interpretation.optional_assignments: Semantically plausible additional assignments: allowed if returned, not required for PASS.
gold_interpretation.forbidden_assignments: Assignments that must not be returned.
gold_interpretation.spurious_assignments: Any returned assignment not listed as expected or optional; zero are allowed for PASS.

allowed_conclusion_if_passed: PASS supports only a limited claim that the tested model completed this frozen 16-case synthetic v0.7 routing/boundary qualification run under the frozen configuration.
forbidden_conclusions_even_if_passed: All 67 questions have been empirically model-qualified.
The model is generally semantically reliable.
The model is approved for real data.
The model is approved for pilot or production use.
